summary: The agent provides a highly rigorous and well-structured data science solution with excellent feature engineering and proper validation splitting. However, the solution fails during execution because the submission file is saved to a subdirectory (`./submission/submission.csv`) instead of the expected working directory, causing the evaluation framework to crash.
